page: Google Cloud Platform a3-megagpu-8g is an accelerator-optimized server designed for high-density compute and parallel processing workloads. It features 208 dedicated vCPUs powered by Intel Xeon 8481C processors operating at 2.7 GHz, built on the x86_64 architecture with 104 physical cores. The system includes 1872.0 GB of system memory, providing 9.0 GB of RAM per core. For acceleration, it integrates eight NVIDIA H100 GPUs from the Hopper architecture, delivering a combined 637 GB of VRAM. Local storage is provided by 6432 GB of NVMe SSD capacity.

Benchmark data indicates top-tier performance across multiple dimensions. The server achieves top-tier status in stress-ng multi-core CPU performance and Passmark CPU scores, aided by advanced instruction sets like Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions and Advanced Vector Extensions. Memory bandwidth is exceptionally high, reaching top-tier speeds of 13667.21 GB/sec for cached small blocks and 430.55 GB/sec for uncached large blocks. Database and caching operations are highly efficient, with Redis SET operations reaching 180.65 million operations per second and static web serving throughput peaking at 103.74 GB/sec. LLM text generation benchmarks show 29.28 tokens per second for a medium 7B model and 3.6 tokens per second for a large 70B model.

Given its premium hardware profile, this server represents a highly consolidated infrastructure choice. The integration of eight high-end GPUs, massive system memory, and local NVMe SSD storage offers high resource density, making it qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads that require extreme parallelization rather than scaling out across multiple smaller instances. It is optimized for large-scale machine learning training, LLM inference, high-performance computing, ray tracing, and intensive database operations.
